deferred.subject: fix(gdn): respect cooperative launch capacity
deferred.reason: two fixes for one class from opposite directions. Upstream sources the multiprocessor count from DeviceContext and partitions token tiles when a cooperative grid exceeds resident capacity; this product's 29caaf34 (alphastorm/ninfer#42) makes the capacity query resolve at the split's step breakpoints so the declared high-water matches the executed plan. Upstream rewrites the same plan (144 lines) and kernels (280 lines) our fix rewrote. Merging them is its own change with the capacity contract test - which sweeps every column count - as the arbiter, not a rider inside a backport.
deferred.next: first item of the next engine window

deferred.subject: fix(frontend): qwen tool argument parsing and embedded tool markup
deferred.reason: both apply to src/targets/qwen3_6/impl/frontend/tool_call_parser.{h,cpp}, files this tree does not have: they were extracted by 70434721 (fix(engine): close tool output and sampling contracts), which is part of the deferred serve-adapter campaign.

deferred.subject: the runtime materialization and pressure fix family, including the fix for upstream #229
deferred.reason: unreachable, not merely risky. The family sits on 099d9032 (feat(runtime): add value-aware shared prefix scheduling), which adds src/runtime/engine/context_portfolio_value.h and shared_capture_planner.h - absent here - and is itself 3,496 insertions across 45 files that rewrite src/serve/openai_common, anthropic_messages_request, openai_responses_request, request_log and translate. Pulling the family therefore pulls the serve-adapter campaign. Where the missing headers do not block (da49c0d6, 03177b91), the remaining conflicts are in pressure_planner.h and program_impl.h, the structures that feature reorganised, so applying them would be a hand port into different scaffolding - in the exact code this product's #37 materialization-residency guard protects.
deferred.value_if_pulled: upstream #229 (fixed 5 ms pressure-search budget forcing root re-prefill for large requests in multi-session states) is this product's workload: agent fanout over host-state slots. The campaign is worth its own window with the pressure_protocol phase at 8 host slots and the fanout anchor phases as the arbiter.
deferred.next: dedicated rebase campaign, highest value of the remaining upstream work

method: cherry-pick -x in upstream topological order onto the mainline head; every applied commit records its upstream source. An empty pick is recorded as already-present. A pick blocked by a file this tree does not have is dropped only when the absent file is incidental (a dflash2 documentation checklist, or src/serve/http_transport.cpp from the deferred serve campaign); otherwise the commit is deferred with its dependency named.
